summary: Well-structured unit tests covering all main components (parsers, aggregation, reporting, workflow structure) with clear names and good error-scenario testing. However, critically missing: (1) act-based integration tests explicitly required by task—tests run via `bun test`, not through GitHub Actions workflow execution as mandated; (2) no `act-result.txt` artifact required by task; (3) edge case gaps in parsers (optional field defaults, XML entities/self-closing tags, special characters in output); (4) workflow tests validate structure and actionlint but never execute workflow end-to-end. Tests would catch regressions in unit logic but fail to verify the entire pipeline works. Fixture files are referenced but not provided—assuming they exist elsewhere, though their absence would prevent test execution. Code quality is good but test strategy is incomplete against stated requirements.
